identitySignals: Name matches: 'Rich Chicks LLC' (company website and SAM-derived GovConInBox/HigherGov profiles) vs. 'Rich Chicks, LLC' in the agenda
Company website says it serves K-12 schools and takes part in USDA school food programs, matching OUSD's RFP for specialty proteins for the K-12 meal program (Nutrition Services)
GovConInBox (SAM-derived) lists physical address 4276 N Tracy Blvd, Tracy, CA, matching the agenda's 'Tracy, CA'
Conflict: HigherGov lists headquarters as Gardena, CA, and the website phone has a 424 (Los Angeles area) area code, while GovConInBox lists Tracy and a 209 phone
research.notes: Headquarters and address left null because sources conflict: HigherGov (SAM data) says Gardena, CA; GovConInBox says 4276 N Tracy Blvd, Tracy, CA (phone 209-879-4104). The company website lists no address and a 424 area-code phone. Tracy may be the plant and Gardena the corporate office, but this is not confirmed. California Secretary of State entity number not found.

profile.summary: A for-profit company that makes chicken products for food service, using small-batch preparation of skinless chicken breast meat. It sells to healthcare, K-12 school and military customers. It takes part in USDA food programs for schools.
